steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Spartan society was organised around military preparedness; full citizens (homoioi/equals) were professional soldiers supported by helot labour | Key Fact: The agoge was the rigorous state education system that trained Spartan boys from age 7 in discipline, endurance and warfare | Key Fact: Helots were the enslaved population of Messenia who farmed the land; they vastly outnumbered citizens and were constantly controlled by fear | Key Fact: The krypteia was a secret police of young Spartans who terrorised and killed helots to prevent rebellion

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from spartan society &amp; the helots, and one past-paper question.
